decisions.rationale: The scanner reports the common serve_forever call, but the server socket is wrapped by a TLS server context before that call. The only plaintext branch requires an explicit lab-only flag and a loopback host; staging and production reject that flag before creating the server.
implemented_controls: All binds are limited to loopback addresses
revisit_when: The server implementation or TLS wrapping changes
The lab plaintext exception is broadened
decisions.sonar_comment: Reviewed false positive: the flagged serve_forever call uses a TLS-wrapped socket. Cleartext requires an explicit lab-only flag and remains loopback-only; staging and production fail closed. Evidence is enforced by test_sonar_security_decisions.py and the ingestion security tests.

decisions.rationale: Container Apps client certificates are not the system authentication boundary. The application uses internal-only ingress, encrypted transport, Entra OIDC for human actors, and separate managed identities for role-isolated validation jobs. Enabling clientCertificateMode without certificate issuance, rotation, revocation, delivery, and application-side validation would be a decorative control and would break current clients.
implemented_controls: Analyst and approver validation jobs use separate managed identities
No application claim relies on an unvalidated forwarded client certificate
required_live_evidence: Public ingress is unavailable from an external execution point
TLS-only ingress is observed in the deployed revision
Analyst and approver role assignments remain distinct
revisit_when: An approved end-to-end mTLS certificate lifecycle is implemented
This decision reaches its expiry date
decisions.sonar_comment: Reviewed architecture acceptance: client certificates are not the authentication boundary. The app is internal-only with TLS, Entra OIDC, and role-isolated managed identities. A complete mTLS lifecycle is not implemented, so setting require would be decorative and would break clients. Acceptance expires 2026-11-08 UTC and live private-ingress evidence remains mandatory before a production verdict.
